lines.text: The man in the door had a rifle. And a *truck.*
lines.style: First-person survivor, tense whisper, eyes squinting into a torch, a beat of surprise on the last word.

lines.text: Easy. We're not biters. We're headed north. *Gull Point.*
lines.style: A middle-aged drifter with a gravelly voice, slow and friendly, a little too friendly, smiling while he talks.

lines.text: Plenty of room in the back. Bring the *dog.*
lines.style: A woman leaning out of a truck window, warm and sweet like honey, with something cold underneath.

lines.text: Fifty miles, in one night. I said *yes.*
lines.style: Narrating quietly, tempted, hopeful, a small smile in the voice.
Teenage girl, low and firm, whispering so the strangers don't hear, no doubt at all.
Narrating, quiet regret, looking back on a mistake.

lines.text: For twenty miles, it felt like we'd *made it.*
lines.style: Narrating over wind, relieved and almost happy, breathing out.
Teenage girl whispering over the wind in the back of a moving truck, uneasy, suspicious.

lines.text: Fuel stop. Go check inside for *water.*
lines.style: The gravelly drifter, casual and easy, as if it means nothing.
Narrating, sudden cold dread, the last word sharp.
Out of breath from running, panicked, disbelieving.
Teenage girl screaming after a truck driving away, voice cracking, heartbroken and furious.

lines.text: I wanted a ride so badly... I never asked what it would *cost.*
lines.style: Narrating, quiet and bitter, slow, a long pause before the last word.

music.title: Last Light - Strangers
music.style: Cinematic survival score. Opens tense and wary with a low drone and ticking pulse. Then a warm, hopeful road theme: soft driving rhythm, gentle strings and a lonely guitar under a night sky. Slowly an uneasy undertone creeps in, detuned and wrong. It ends in a sudden betrayal: a hard dark swell, then a slow, sad, empty piano. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
